purpose: Add a governed one-time approved action execution window to the Windows real-alpha actuator so approved requests can execute exactly once and immediately lock back.
root_cause: The actuator returns reason real_alpha_locked_after_209_blocks_open_app and has no discovered approval-window or arm-approved-action endpoint.

required_patch_design.endpoint_purpose: Create a short-lived one-action execution window for one approved request/action only.
required_patch_design.allowed_action_scope: real_open_app only for approved request approval-real_open_app-20260706-002139 unless future catalog expands
reject_if: execution_state is not APPROVED_NOT_EXECUTED or APPROVED_NOT_EXECUTED_BLOCKED_UNTIL_284
any second action after first attempt

proposed_governance_sequence_after_patch: 284E audit patched endpoint remains locked by default
284F arm one approved action window no execution
284G execute one approved action using one-time window and lockback
explicit_non_goals: Do not allow type-text under open-app approval
Do not add UI execute buttons yet
